levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for the suspicious activity.
levels.solution:
1. Access the target host:
```bash
ssh cyrano@target
```
2. List all services:
```bash
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```
3. Identify suspicious services:
Look for services with unusual names or descriptions. Pay attention to services that are not part of the standard system services.
4. Check the status of suspicious services:
```bash
systemctl status <service_name>
```
5. Identify the service responsible for suspicious activity:
The service name is the hidden flag.

levels.title: Identify Network Port
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Access the target host:
```bash
ssh cyrano@target
```
2. List all listening ports:
```bash
ss -tulnp
```
3. Identify the port associated with the suspicious service:
Look for ports that are not part of the standard system services.
4. Check the service configuration:
```bash
systemctl cat <service_name>
```
5. Identify the network port associated with the suspicious activity:
The port number is the hidden flag.
